title: The Parable of the Watchful Servants
description: Jesus urges the disciples to have their belts fastened and their lamps burning, telling a parable about servants waiting for their master returning from a wedding feast. Blessed are those found awake when he comes—then the master himself will gird himself and serve them. Like a thief, the Son of Man comes at an hour no one expects, so they must be ready. [ref:Luk 12:35-40|Luke 12:35-40]
